newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks gain at close as synthetics rise.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks gain at close as synthetics rise.

text.p: Pakistan stocks ended slightly up on Thursday as synthetic stocks rose amid talk of higher regulatory duties on imported fibres, dealers said.

"Synthetic stocks including Dewan Salman Fibres, gained on hopes that duty on imported fibres will be raised shortly," dealer Sajjad Mankani said. "But overall sentiment was mixed as investors remained on the sidelines ahead of the budget."

The budget for 1997/98 (July-June) is to be announced on June 14. The Karachi 100-share index rose 4.04 points, or 0.26 percent, to end at 1,545.93. Losers led gainers 190 to 61. Dewan Salman rose 0.75 rupees to 36.40. -- Amir Zia 9221-5685192
